messages:
rachel: Heads up 9 - a bunch of onboarding runs are stuck in retry loops because SDK surfaces generic 4xx as retriable. Support is seeing repeated rate-limit hits.

devin: is this the metadata JSON parsing case?

rachel: yes. backend returns 400 with body like `{"error":{"kind":"parse_error","msg":"metadata must be an object"}}` but SDK throws BadRequest with no subtype or retriable flag.

noor: we should map server `error.kind` -> typed exceptions and include a `retriable` boolean and `help_url` on the error object. minimal change: inspect body during error unmarshal, no extra network calls.

harry: agreed. mapping proposal: `parse_error` -> ParseError(retriable=false), `validation_error` -> ValidationError(retriable=false), `auth_error` -> AuthError(retriable=false, actionHint), 429 -> RateLimitError(retriable=true, retryAfter). default: BadRequest(retriable=false).

rachel: sample snippet for TS: ```ts
const kind = body?.error?.kind || inferKind(body, headers);
switch(kind){
 case 'parse_error': throw new ParseError(body.error.msg, {code: 'ERR_PARSE', retriable:false, help_url: body.error.help_url});
 case 'rate_limited': throw new RateLimitError('quota', {retriable:true, retryAfter: headers['retry-after']});
 default: throw new BadRequest(body.error?.msg || 'bad request', {retriable:false});
}
```

devin: good. add `code` (stable machine id) too so integrators can switch from message regex to code.

noor: sampleapp change: stop blanket retry. replace `retryOnAnyError` with `if (err.retriable) retryWithBackoff()` and show a user help link when available.

harry: tests: unit tests for mapping with and without `error.kind`, e2e where sampleapp submits malformed metadata and verify no retry loop. also update CI mock fixtures.

err-bot: Ticket created DX-2024: SDK typed error mapping and DX-2025: sampleapp retry policy.

rachel: owners: devin -> TS, harry -> Go, noor -> sampleapp/docs. timeline: small PRs this week. I'll drop changelog text: "SDK: introduce ParseError/ValidationError/RateLimitError and retriable flag; sampleapp uses explicit retry semantics."

devin: will include migration note: apps that matched on error message should switch to `err.code` or `err.retriable`.

noor: UI copy suggestion: "We couldn't process your metadata (ERR_PARSE). See help: /docs/onboarding#metadata or contact support with request id." keeps it user friendly.

harry: note for infra: some older responses omit `error.kind`; SDKs must fallback to simple heuristics (Retry-After header -> RateLimit, message contains 'token' -> Auth). please coordinate with infra to standardize payload shape.

rachel: nice, small change but should cut the noisy retries. :white_check_mark:
